name: Brazatortas (Spain)
description: Divided diagonally from the upper hoist to the lower fly by a broad white band, red above and green below, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Brazatortas (a tree, ears of wheat and a boar on white and green).
history: Municipal flag of Brazatortas; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: broad band from the upper hoist to the lower fly
